thread:
Ava (Marketing): Quick sync on co-marketing ops for Cloud Connectors launch. Agenda: 1) joint webinar + date poll; 2) benchmark blog + data ownership; 3) marketplace listing timing; 4) inbound lead routing & UTMs. Link to deck: https://drive.redwood/cc-launch-deck. Please call out owners/blockers. :wave:

Diego (Partnerships): Can we aim for webinar week of Apr 12? Partner prefers Tue or Thu. They want a partner speaker + 20m demo slot. Also want marketplace listing live same week for demo-to-lead flow. cc @Noah

Priya (Product): Technical content ready on our side. We can produce a short 4-step benchmark showing latency/cost vs baseline models (p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token). I can own the benchmark scripts + dataset. Question: do we run tests on our infra or do partners want to run on theirs for parity? Need conv sample and eval prompts from partner.

Sam (Growth): Inbound routing proposal: registration form with a 'partner' dropdown, hidden inputs utm_source=partner, utm_campaign=cloud-connectors. Route leads where partner != 'self-serve' to Partnership SDR queue. I'll draft SFDC field mapping and Zapier flow. Add lead_tag: cloud-connectors.

Noah (Sales): If leads go to Partnership SDRs what's the SLA? 24h response ok? Also want a lead scoring threshold so we don't route low-intent signups. Can we add a 'marketplace listing interest' checkbox on the form?

Diego (Partnerships): Partner says they can do a short demo but prefer we run the benchmark tests on our infra and share results. They will provide the model artifact and example traffic for realistic load. For the co-authored blog they need 3 business days for legal review.

Ava (Marketing): Timeline suggestion: Week 1 - announce webinar + registration page (Sam). Week 2 - run benchmarks & draft blog (Priya + Diego). Week 3 - partner review + legal (3 business days). Week 4 - webinar + marketplace listing + launch post. Does that look ok? :calendar:

Priya (Product): Sample tracking snippet for the registration form — we should capture partner and utm tags and fire a GA event on submit:
```html
<form id="cc-reg">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_source" value="partner">
  <input type="hidden" name="utm_campaign" value="cloud-connectors">
  <input type="hidden" name="partner_name" value="CloudVendorX">
  <button type="submit">Register</button>
</form>
<script>document.getElementById('cc-reg').addEventListener('submit', ()=>ga('send','event','webinar','register','cloud-connectors'))</script>
```

Sam (Growth): I'll wire that up and create the Zapier -> SFDC mapping. Notes: map lead.Source = 'Marketplace' if utm_source contains 'marketplace', else 'Web'. I'll draft the field mapping doc. @Noah please share SDR queue ID.

Noah (Sales): SLA 24h ok. Queue ID: SD-PART-03. We'll prep a 15-min demo slot in the playbook and a 3-email nurture for marketplace leads.

Ava (Marketing): Owners recap: Webinar page & registration = Sam. Benchmark + blog = Priya & Diego. Marketplace listing = Diego. Legal review = Marketing Legal (assign separately). Sales follow-up playbook = Noah. I'll send calendar invites and update the deck with these owners by EOD. Any blockers? :rocket:

calendar-bot: Poll created — https://cal.example/poll/abc (options: Tue Apr 13 / Wed Apr 14 / Thu Apr 15)

Diego (Partnerships): 👍 will sync with partner PM tomorrow, need sample dataset access by Friday to start benchmarks.

Sam (Growth): ✅ I'll set up the form, Zap, and draft the SFDC mapping doc. @Noah dropping the queue ID into the doc now.

Ava (Marketing): Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll push an updated deck and a checklist in the project board. Followups: Sam to share registration URL once live; Priya to share initial benchmark results snapshot in 5 days.

(End of thread)
